context: Tests whether the agent uses the Hanami params block DSL correctly: type coercion, enum constraints, nested hash params, array or cross-field rules, and returns 422 with structured errors on validation failure.

checklist.name: params block in Action
checklist.description: The `params do ... end` block is defined inside the Action class body — NOT in a separate contract file, NOT in the repository, and NOT after the class definition

checklist.name: Integer coercion for amount
checklist.description: The `amount` field uses `:integer` type coercion (e.g., `required(:amount).value(:integer, ...)`) — NOT `:string` or untyped

checklist.name: Nested hash params
checklist.description: The `payment` field uses `.hash { }` to declare a nested structure (e.g., `required(:payment).hash { ... }`) — NOT a flat key or an untyped hash

checklist.name: included_in? for plan
checklist.description: The `plan` field uses `included_in?` predicate to restrict values to the allowed plan names (e.g., `value(:string, included_in?: %w[basic premium enterprise])`)

checklist.name: format? for email
checklist.description: The `email` field uses a `format?` predicate with a regex to validate the email pattern

checklist.name: cross-field rule
checklist.description: A `rule(...)` block is present to implement the cross-field validation (checking both plan and amount together)

checklist.name: 422 on invalid params
checklist.description: The `#handle` method returns HTTP 422 with a structured error body when params are invalid (either via automatic halt or explicit check of `request.params.errors`)

checklist.name: Structured error response
checklist.description: The error response body includes the validation errors hash (e.g., `{ errors: request.params.errors.to_h }`) — NOT a plain string message

checklist.name: 201 on success
checklist.description: The `#handle` method sets `response.status = 201` (or equivalent) on the success path

checklist.name: No validation in service/repo
checklist.description: There is no second params validation or schema check in any repository or service object called from the action — validation stays in the Action's params block

checklist.name: optional referral_code
checklist.description: The `referral_code` field is declared with `optional(...)` — NOT `required`
